CharacterSubmission.title: CharacterSubmission
CharacterSubmission.description: Private character registration submitted by a gala guest before organizer sync to Google Sheets.

nombre.description: Guest name chosen from the invitation roster.

email.description: Guest email address for their private character sheet.

syncedToSheets.description: Whether the organizer has synced this submission to their private Google Sheet.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of when the guest submitted the character.

syncedAt.description: Server timestamp of when the organizer synced this entry to Google Sheets.

RumorSubmission.title: RumorSubmission
RumorSubmission.description: Confidential Lady Nebula rumor submitted by a guest before organizer sync to Google Sheets.

anonymous.description: Whether the submission was sent anonymously.

mania.description: Quirk or anecdote about the target guest.

chisme.description: Optional rumor for Lady Nebula's chronicle.

syncedToSheets.description: Whether the organizer has synced this rumor to their private Google Sheet.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of when the rumor was submitted.

syncedAt.description: Server timestamp of when the organizer synced this entry to Google Sheets.

OrganizerSheetConfig.title: OrganizerSheetConfig
OrganizerSheetConfig.description: Private organizer configuration storing the linked Google Spreadsheet ID and title.

spreadsheetId.description: Private Google Spreadsheet ID owned by the organizer.

title.description: Display title of the organizer's Google Spreadsheet.

updatedBy.description: Verified organizer email that last updated the config.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Authorized organizer record keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was created.

/characterSubmissions/{submissionId}.description: Write-only dropbox for guest character forms; readable and manageable strictly by the organizer.

/rumorSubmissions/{submissionId}.description: Write-only dropbox for confidential Lady Nebula rumors; readable and manageable strictly by the organizer.

/organizerConfig/{configId}.description: Private organizer Google Sheets settings; strictly inaccessible to guests.
